results.text: Investigation of Severe Hypoglycemia Risk Among Patients with Diabetes Treated with Ultra-Rapid Lispro in Japan. There is no information on the incidence of severe hypoglycemia in real-world patients with diabetes receiving ultra-rapid lispro (URLi). This post-marketing, observational, safety study assessed the incidence proportion and incidence rate of the first severe hypoglycemia event requiring a hospital visit in URLi-treated patients. results.text: Severe hypoglycaemia is associated with increased risk of adverse cardiovascular complications in adults with type 1 diabetes: risk mitigation using intermittently scanned continuous glucose monitoring.
